title: Piplup's First Bubble Lesson
description: A proud Piplup lifts one flipper to send shimmering bubbles across a polar lagoon. Its rounded navy hood, white cheek mask, sparkling eyes, yellow bill, broad webbed feet and twin white chest spots create the unmistakable little penguin. A scalloped ice shelf, swimming fish and rising bubble trail form one connected display.
